title: NZ MBIE Determination 2026/017 (comparative): certificate of acceptance for a retrofitted shower room
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Auckland Council; comparative only, not Alberta
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992) as cited; E3/AS1 second edition, amendment 7 and G13/AS1 second edition, amendment 9 as cited
source_url_note: Building CodeHub resource page for the same MBIE determination (Information provider: MBIE); the building.govt.nz determination page is WAF-blocked for this worker.

facts.text: The authority issued certificate of acceptance COA04522498 for alterations creating a new shower room where a previous bathroom existed.
The alteration work was carried out in or about May 2023.
A proprietary liquid waterproof membrane was applied under ceramic tiles to the shower enclosure and adjacent space, supported by a workmanship warranty.
A later report from a licensed building practitioner alleged issues including the reduced size of the floor waste pipe.
Figure 2 shows the subfloor space below the floor waste and wash hand basin; Figure 3 shows the ventilation fitting.
